text_block_list.name: North Flight
choice_data_list: Are you okay? Feeling a bit anemic?
Are you okay? Feeling a bit anemic?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
No, it's really nothing!
It's just that last night I was reading 'Big Sis's' letter, so...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Your writing is so wonderful, Big Sis.
It makes my heart feel as light as a feather,
so I just love it.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
*Yawn*... I wonder how they're doing.
I want to see them again...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She looks unusually relaxed and happy,
but her footing seems somewhat unsteady.
It looks like she didn't get a good rest...
